name: LagNode
label: Lag
description: Adds a column with the value of a source column from a row that is offset rows earlier within each partition. Rows without an earlier row get the default value.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute lag values for.

fields.name: SourceColumn
fields.label: Source Column
fields.description: The column whose earlier values are retrieved.

fields.name: Offset
fields.label: Offset
fields.description: The number of rows to look back. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: DefaultValue
fields.label: Default Value
fields.description: Optional value used when no earlier row exists within the partition.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. Lag does not cross partition boundaries.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the lag column. Defaults to '<SourceColumn>_Lag<Offset>'.
